calls.summary:
# Emmy/Ashley
Date: 2026-08-20 | Duration: 34.81999969482422m

## Summary
The team is focusing on repositioning the company as a leader in experimentation platforms, emphasizing comprehensive experimentation over basic feature flagging. They brainstormed five candidate key messages, with key contenders highlighting advanced experimentation capabilities and accessibility for all teams. An initiative to conduct ten user interviews was discussed, aimed at understanding signup motivations and onboarding experiences among recent users, incentivized by a gift card. Improvements to the GitHub readme and SEO strategies were also reviewed, including adding a section for open-source competitors and enhancing SDK setup instructions. Furthermore, strategies for community engagement through GitHub and Slack as well as automating user satisfaction tracking via an NPS survey system were outlined.

## Keywords
experimentation platform, user interviews, onboarding experience, GitHub marketing, README optimization, G2 reviews

## Action Items

**Emmy Sharp**
Create a user interview question document and initiate outreach to conduct ten user interviews with recent free signup users, offering $50 gift cards for 15-minute interviews to understand signup motivations, onboarding experience, pain points, and opportunities for improvement (04:10)
Set up a Slack group including Ashley Stirrup, Alyssa, and Guy to align on interview goals, questions, and coordination for user interviews and feedback collection (14:10)
Review and update the GrowthBook GitHub README to enhance marketing impact by adding sections such as use cases, competitive alternatives with careful wording, explicit Q&A/FAQ markdown, and boilerplate code snippets for easier SDK setup (19:14)
Research and optimize GitHub topic tags and README content to maximize discoverability without aggressive keyword stuffing, leveraging Ashley Stirrup's input on strategic messaging (27:41)
Monitor incoming NPS survey results via Slack, prioritize outreach to very satisfied customers, and encourage them to leave G2 reviews as part of the marketing and user feedback strategy (31:25)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Provide Emmy Sharp with examples and suggestions for keyword-optimized release notes to support GitHub marketing efforts (29:54)
Coordinate with Guy to finalize the process for G2 reviews and the rollout of the NPS survey to ensure smooth execution of user feedback and marketing initiatives (31:34)
Follow up asynchronously on GitHub marketing strategy and competition messaging after Emmy Sharp completes initial updates and research (31:08)
